title.narrative: Climate Resilience and Disaster Management in CARICOM

description.narrative:
This project aims to strengthen Comprehensive Disaster Management (CDM) systems at both the national and community levels across CDEMA Participating States, enhancing the region’s overall resilience to natural hazards. By supporting governments, institutions, and local communities, the project promotes coordinated, inclusive, and sustainable disaster risk management.
As a result of these efforts, communities are becoming more resilient, schools are safer and better prepared for emergencies, and regional disaster management capacity is being improved through targeted training and knowledge exchange. The project also works to increase the adoption of safer building practices, reducing exposure and vulnerability to future disasters.
